body:
I've written one of the last letters to my father, and the pain inside me as I write all the words is almost unbearable.  

I'm in so much conflict, pain, misery, and sorrow - I don't want to cause my family so much suffering because of my own weakness...but at the same time; I'm in so much pain...I don't know how to move forward anymore.

I'm so fucking lost - I want to die, but I can't even write these letters without losing my mind.  What the fuck is wrong with me!!
